notes.title: PogoStadium Dev Secret :Part1
notes.content: [p][/p][p][/p][p]Hello.[/p][p]We will regularly share behind-the-scenes episodes from the development of Pogo Stadium and highlight points that the developers recommend.[/p][p][/p][p]The first installment comes from the stage design team![/p][p][/p][h3]At the initiative of the person in charge, [b]we created[/b] [b]over[/b] [b]100 different battle stages.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596828/baaaa709593d9995e06e01d6c0773bb007ed1507.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Our pick: random stages + 4-player matches![/b][/h3][p]Terrain, starting positions, and gimmicks — everything changes every round, so it's total chaos for everyone!![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596828/621f854489424f340c7e0436d86c15b6ede02c7d.png"][/img][/p][p]▲Here's just a sneak peek of the blueprint for the battle stage where Apollo and the gang bounce around![/p][p]Gimmicks, shapes, and the characters' starting positions — there's creativity everywhere ✨[/p][p][/p][p]Those columns of numbers are totally striking.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]And when we hand these blueprints to the programmers and have them implemented in the game...[/p][p][/p][h3]▼For example, a heart-shaped blueprint...[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596828/7aa14dd3482faf773daec2537f9a9811c2eb56fe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]▼And this is how it looks!!!! What a surprise — can you believe it?![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596828/f8c919923bb0e6c2dbfbd0fc80ed6b367b618431.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]You can play via 'Remote Play Together', so be sure to play with friends who don't own the game — even if they're far away![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596828/dc6ea9e278ea91c4dcad9182020272e09e22e575.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672410/POGO_Stadium/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Ver.1.0.5 Hotfix is now live!
notes.content: [p]Thank you for playing POGO Stadium![/p][p]We’ve just released a Hotfix update (Ver.1.0.5). This update addresses an issue discovered during our internal debugging where the game would sometimes fail to recognize controllers when multiple controllers are connected.[/p][p][/p][p]◆ Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where controllers would not be recognized when multiple controllers are connected[/p][/*][/list][p]Your feedback is always welcome, please keep sharing your thoughts with us 👇[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: POGO Stadium: Switch Launch Celebration Sale 33% OFF!
notes.content: [p]To celebrate the release of POGO Stadium on Nintendo Switch™, we are holding [b]a special Steam sale.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Sale Period [/p][p]- UK (BST): September 4, 08:00 — September 18, 08:00 [/p][p]- US Eastern (EDT): September 4, 03:00 — September 18, 03:00 [/p][p]- US Pacific (PDT): September 4, 00:00 — September 18, 00:00[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672410/POGO_Stadium/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][b]POGO Stadium[/b] is a rhythmic territory battle where you hop from square to square, clear blocks, and expand your domain.  [/p][p]Blending rhythm, quick reactions, and [b]puzzle-like strategy[/b], it challenges both your reflexes and your tactical mind.  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Multiplayer rounds for two to four players[/b] are described as “super exciting” and [b]Remote Play Together is supported[/b], so friends can join even if they don’t own the game.  [/p][p]Battle Mode features over 100 stages, playable against CPUs or up to four players locally.  [/p][p]Solo Mode offers [b]45 arcade-style stages[/b] with puzzle depth and story progression to enjoy at your own pace.  [/p][p][/p][p]Colorful animal characters and upbeat music complete the lively atmosphere.  [/p][p]Take this chance to experience the thrill of the stadium at a special price.[/p]

Your feedback has been a huge help in improving the game.  [/p][p]Please keep sharing your thoughts with us 👇  [/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 『POGO Stadium』Early Access Launch 🚀
notes.content: [p]The stadium lights are on and the skyline is shaking—[b]POGO Stadium[/b] has arrived in Early Access.[/p][p][/p][p]Land blocks on the beat, sever platforms in a flash, and watch floating islands switch to your color before they drop into the neon abyss. Every jump is a decision. Every beat is a chance to outsmart rivals.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596828/44abf57132df193a9fe8a1c1a92de2c1904ec6fc.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596828/74652b4459b2bc19016729c7f655523b2824183b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596828/462b21bb72268135ed7066b6b602227c4764978b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596828/2adc37d205167379f22a62df62afc36a9803aeaa.png"][/img][/carousel][h3][b]Key Features[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]• Solo Challenge[/b][/p][p]Tackle 45 carefully tuned stages across nine zones that sharpen timing, strategy, and nerves.[/p][p][/p][p][b]• Battle Mode[/b][/p][p]More than 100 handcrafted arenas host frantic local showdowns for up to four players. Pure skill and smart Effector use decide the victor.[/p][p][/p][p][b]• Effector Loadouts[/b][/p][p]Equip stage-shaping effects that freeze foes, create walls, or carve shortcuts. No stat boosts—only tactical mind games.[/p][p][/p][p][b]• Six Stylized Competitors[/b][/p][p]Choose from six expressive animal athletes, each with unique animations and emotes. Unlock skins and gear through in-game achievements.[/p][p][/p][p][b]• High-Energy Original Soundtrack[/b][/p][p]Composer Shinobu Amayake drives every hop with a pulse-pounding score that synchronizes perfectly with the action.[/p][p][/p][p]Pick a character, feel the rhythm, and claim every last island. Claim the stadium and make your mark.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672410/POGO_Stadium"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: We’ve Updated the Demo 1.0.2
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, just a quick update before Steam Next Fest kicks off!
We’ve made some tweaks based on your feedback, thank you so much for playing and sharing your thoughts![/p][hr][/hr][p]■ [b]Changes in this update[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]tutorial system[/b] has been improved!
You can now access and progress through it anytime.
Perfect for first-timers and those who want a quick refresher.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Area 2 - Stage 1[/b]:
Earning stars in the post-clear “completion challenge” has been made a bit easier.
Let’s see those perfect clears![/p][/*][*][p]The default [b]volume setting[/b] now starts at 50.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]■ [b]Big thanks to everyone who shared feedback[/b]
Your input helps us make [i]POGO Stadium[/i] better for everyone. Keep it coming![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3672410/discussions/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your support!
See you in the stadium during [b]Steam Next Fest![/b][/p]

[/p][p]We appreciate it and hope you keep enjoying it.[/p]
